what: Mettler-Toledo makes precision instruments: laboratory balances, pipettes, titrators and analytical instruments, industrial weighing and inspection systems for factories, and retail scales for supermarkets.
customers: Pharmaceutical and chemical laboratories, food and packaging manufacturers, and retailers.
money: balances, pipettes, titration and analytical instruments
factory weighing, product inspection and transport logistics
moat: Instruments embedded in regulated laboratory and factory procedures, with a direct sales and service force that competitors with distributors cannot match.
risks: Pharmaceutical and chemical customers cut instrument spending sharply in recent years
Revenue has been roughly flat over three years
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Gross margin of 59% with a long record of raising prices above inflation
Service and consumables provide recurring revenue through downturns
It has shrunk its share count consistently through buybacks
watch: Order growth by region, especially China, and laboratory instrument demand.
